name: Video: How PSX games were developed

mentions.name: Video: How PSX games were developed
mentions.description: A ten-minute YouTube video for the jbreckmckye channel about how PlayStation 1 games were developed, covering the tools, languages, and practices common in that era, as well as the computers and software used for creating assets (e.g., Irix Framethrower for SGI). Currently in the writing stage.
